title: Partial and Expression Indexes
description: Create a partial index on orders for only 'pending' status orders. Then create an expression index on LOWER(email) in the customers table. Query using both indexes. Return columns: name, email, total.
hints: Partial index: CREATE INDEX idx_pending_orders ON orders(status) WHERE status = 'pending'
Expression index: CREATE INDEX idx_lower_email ON customers(LOWER(email))
Query must use the same expression: WHERE LOWER(email) = 'alice@example.com'
The partial index is only used when WHERE matches the condition
